title: Project Hub 1.0 target C01-C12 contract bundle
description: TARGET ONLY: proposed planning contract, not current implementation or customer policy approval.

Id.description: Existing positive integer PKs, fixtures such as P1, and new stable string IDs.

CnyCents.description: CNY minor unit only; JSON number must be integer, not float/bool.

Money.x-contract-rule: all v1 entities use CNY; no float or yuan input

PolicyVersion.x-contract-rule: only approved policy versions may support formal posting

AlgorithmVersion.x-contract-rule: persist exact version and inputs; new versions never recalculate posted history

x-service-invariants: Resolve namespace/kind through this registry; then verify tenant/project and requested immutable version under company lock.
Source identity is canonical owner+kind+stable id+immutable version; namespace aliases must be migration mappings, never separate live identities.

locks.const: organization, period, project, sources, cash_transaction, open_item, allocation sorted by stable id

history.const: append/reverse/forward-adjust only; never update posted ledger or snapshot

rounding.const: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP; strict reversal preserves original cents

x-service-invariants: Server resolves approved policy version and effective dates; input cannot assert approval or actor.
Only contracts owns the approved choice; read pricing_template/method_policy are derived snapshots of this configuration.
Fixed price milestone allocations sum to line net; retention is within price, never additional revenue.
Confirmed-time price=Decimal(unit_price_cents)*customer-confirmed minutes/unit_minutes, group HALF_UP, cumulative cap and unique confirmed coverage enforced.

Service schedule intervals nonoverlap within line term; allocated amounts sum to line net; approved whole-period confirmations consume schedule once. Partial periods require explicitly approved calendar-days rule, otherwise reject.
Cross-line/project/time/service coverage overlaps rejected; contract parent provides project and counterparty.
Sum salary_components=salary pool total; one active employee/month/method version after correction.
Sum approved minutes <= confirmed capacity; otherwise block final allocation until customer confirms corrected capacity/overtime policy.
Group target by project/nonproject id; missing capacity minutes have explicit unallocated destination. No arbitrary allocation to projects.
Total raw weights including unallocated = capacity; total source cents recognized once at company level. Allocation is a distribution, not another company cost.

Compute Decimal raw target=C*minutes/capacity; group_total=ROUND_HALF_UP(sum(raw)); floor raw targets then distribute integer residual by descending fractional remainder, ties by target_kind then stable target_id; never Python float.
Allocated projects+nonproject+unallocated == group_total == salary pool cents; reversal uses persisted allocations, never recomputes old inputs.
Capacity, approved-minute dates and source cost refer to the same confirmed incurred coverage. No future business date or planned full-month amount is posted as incurred.
The current cumulative labor amount and every estimate-to-actual correction are linked to the original employee/month claim and prior immutable snapshots.
Customer confirms component inclusion/capacity policy and evidence; server resolves approved timesheets and target weights itself.
Missing capacity or approved policy blocks final allocation; no implicit zero or undocumented pro-rata.

This is draft input only. Missing/null/zero capacity can preserve salary facts but cannot become a final allocation snapshot; final MonthlyLaborInputs still requires positive confirmed capacity and policy.
